question: The mean and the mode of a data set are 33.9 and 40.1, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula. (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
solution:
**Given:**

Mean = 33.9

Mode = 40.1

**Formula used:**

Empirical formula: Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Calculation:**

40.1 = 3(Median) - 2(33.9)

⇒ 40.1 = 3(Median) - 67.8

⇒ 40.1 + 67.8 = 3(Median)

⇒ 107.9 = 3(Median)

⇒ Median = 107.9 ÷ 3

⇒ Median = 35.97

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
